title: Yummy Slovakian Lamb Flatbread
description: Savory flatbread topped with thinly sliced lamb, paprika, and onion, baked to a crisp finish. A light, ovo-vegetarian dish that showcases long-fermented dough and traditional Slovakian flavors.
instructions: In a bowl, combine bread flour, salt, and instant yeast.
Add warm water and olive oil to the dry mixture and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled container, cover, and let it ferment at room temperature for 12 hours.
After fermentation, punch down the dough and divide it into two equal portions.
Roll each portion into a 12-inch circle on a parchment sheet.
Spread sliced lamb chops evenly over the dough, sprinkle smoked paprika, oregano, and thin onion slices.
Brush the edges of the dough with beaten egg to create a golden crust.
Bake the flatbreads in a preheated oven at 220°C for 12 minutes until edges are crisp.
Remove from oven, let cool 5 minutes, then slice and serve hot.
